name: ecs-healthcheck-doctor
description: Diagnoses Amazon ECS service health-check mismatches - pulls the container health-check and ALB target-group health-check config, recent stopped-task reasons, and target health, then flags the specific mismatch: grace period too short, health-check path or port wrong, security group blocking ALB-to-task, protocol mismatch, or container healthCheck disagreeing with the target-group healthCheck. Produces a ranked, read-only-safe remediation plan. Read-only. Recommends the AWS Documentation MCP as augmentation. This is the health-check-mismatch angle, not deployment-stability monitoring.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on THU at 04:00 UTC
